    AI Overview
    +2
    France's Agathe Laisne won the 2026 Joburg Ladies Open in a dramatic five-hole playoff on April 19, 2026, at Randpark Golf Club, finishing at 19-under-par to secure her second Ladies European Tour (LET) title. She defeated Kirsten Rudgeley and Casandra Alexander in the marathon playoff, which finished in the dark on the Firethorn course. 
    Watch the highlights of Agathe Laisne's marathon playoff win:
    45s
    Agathe Laisne wins Joburg Ladies Open after MARATHON ...
    Ladies European Tour
    YouTube• Apr 19, 2026
    Key Details of the 2026 Tournament 
    • Winner: Agathe Laisne (France)
    • Runner-up: Kirsten Rudgeley (Australia)
    • Third Place: Casandra Alexander (South Africa)
    • Venue: Randpark Golf Club (Firethorn Course), Johannesburg
    • Dates: April 16–19, 2026
    • Prize Fund: €330,000
    • Tour Co-sanctioning: Ladies European Tour (LET) and Sunshine Ladies Tour (SLT) 
    Tournament Highlights 
    • Dramatic Finish: Laisne and Rudgeley both birdied the 18th in the first playoff hole to eliminate South Africa's Alexander.
    • Marathon Playoff: After several matching scores, the 18th hole was shortened to a 78-yard pitch for the final playoff hole, where Laisne secured a 10-foot birdie putt for the win.
    • Leaderboard Shift: The final round saw intense competition, with France’s Camille Chevalier and Celine Herbin leading going into the final day before Laisne and Rudgeley surged ahead.
    • Weather Impact: Play was briefly delayed during the final round due to thunder and lightning. 
    The tournament was the 12th edition of the event and the 7th stop on the 2026 LET season schedule.
